title: Vagrant Lifecycle and Provisioning
objective: Connect machine creation, provisioning, and cleanup into a repeatable lab cycle.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.
sourceAlignment.chapterTitle: Local Infrastructure Development: Ansible and Vagrant

paragraphs: Vagrant creates a VM from a declared box and networking configuration; Ansible then converges its operating-system state. Keeping those responsibilities separate makes playbooks portable.
Use vagrant up to create, provision to rerun configuration, ssh for diagnosis, and destroy for a clean retry. A clean rebuild exposes assumptions hidden by accumulated state.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Connect machine creation, provisioning, and cleanup into a repeatable lab cycle.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:
lab_cycle:
  create: vagrant up
  configure: vagrant provision
  inspect: vagrant ssh
  clean: vagrant destroy -f
examples.note: Use this as a reasoning model before applying changes to the disposable lab.
